item: The cross-site GET refusal judges Origin and Referer by the POST middleware's own rule and now covers GET /api/geo/downloads/size (R284)
refs: R278; R284; A-014; 0.5.1 audit get-side-effects table
summary: Two changes to the dependency shipped in #1526. (1) Origin or Referer was compared with Host as a raw string, so a reverse proxy that sets Host oo.lan:443 with a browser Origin https://oo.lan was refused on a guarded GET that carried an Origin, while the POST middleware let it through; the dependency now calls the middleware's own _foreign_origin (default ports normalised, hostname must be one the app serves, Origin null refused). A test pins the proxy pair and four different-server cases; it fails on the raw compare. (2) GET /api/geo/downloads/size, which made the outbound HEAD to the OSM mirror for a foreign page while online, carries the dependency (OSM lane's proposal A-014, option A); a test shows no HEAD for a cross-site request and one each for the own page and a script. The wiki dump probes were already covered by #1526. SECURITY.md now lists every guarded GET and keeps the stated limit and the POST proposal. database.py's private raw-compare copy is Export's to repoint.
